grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count 44721 with duplicate_row_rate 0.0, meaning no two rows are byte-identical, so the table is not a pre-aggregated summary; each row records one product (stock_code) sold or returned on one invoice (invoice_id). invoice_id alone has distinct_count 2330, far fewer than row_count, so invoice_id cannot identify a single line on its own; the derived identity hashes invoice_id with stock_code to produce a stable per-line key, matching the pattern of one invoice carrying many product lines. Because duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 the identity tuple does not need to absorb any exact duplicates, so transaction grain with a derived degenerate identifier is the correct fit rather than aggregation.

fields.name: invoice_id
fields.description: Invoice number such as 489434 with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 2330, identifying the parent invoice a line belongs to; it is a dimension/identifier, not a measure.

fields.name: is_cancellation
fields.description: Boolean flag with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_values [false, true] marking whether the line represents a cancelled/returned transaction, used to segment events rather than to be summed.

fields.name: stock_code
fields.description: Product/stock code such as 10002 or 10123C with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 3141, identifying which product the line concerns; it labels rather than measures.

fields.name: product_description
fields.description: Free-text product name such as '12 PENCILS SMALL TUBE POSY' with null_rate 0.005098 (228 nulls), nullable likely because some stock codes lack a recorded description; it is descriptive, not numeric.

fields.name: quantity
fields.description: Units sold or returned per line, ranging from -1395 to 5184 with null_rate 0.0; negative values align with the is_cancellation flag, and the field is additive across lines so it is a measure.

fields.name: invoiced_at
fields.description: Timestamp of the invoice line ranging from 2009-12-01T07:45:00 to 2009-12-23T16:58:00 with null_rate 0.0 and minute-level sample values such as '2009-12-01T07:46:00', so the event is timestamped to the minute.

fields.name: unit_price
fields.description: Per-unit price ranging from 0.0 to 1998.49 with null_rate 0.0, used in revenue-type computations across lines, so it is a measure.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.description: Customer identifier ranging from 12346 to 18287 with null_rate 0.300664 (13446 nulls), nullable because many invoice lines are recorded without a known customer (e.g. guest or unattributed sales); it identifies rather than measures.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country of the invoice such as 'Australia' or 'Germany' with null_rate 0.0 and distinct_count 24, labeling the geography of the transaction.

category_description: One row represents a single product line item recorded against an invoice: a specific stock_code sold or returned at a given unit_price and quantity, timestamped by invoiced_at, attributable to a customer and country when known.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver.silver_invoice_lines table enters the gold unified event star as the invoice_lines fact category, specifying its time column, grain, degenerate identifier, and field roles for the deterministic modeling engine that generates the gold models from this contract.
usage: The rendered mapping contract is validated against the frozen mapping-contract schema, linted, and reviewed by a human before approval; once approved, the deterministic modeling engine consumes it to emit the gold fact model for invoice line events, with no further transformation performed by this mapping.
limitations: This mapping does not decide whether cancellation rows (is_cancellation=true, negative quantity) should be excluded or netted against sales; that filtering or netting logic is left to downstream consumers. It also does not resolve the 30.07% null rate on customer_id into a synthetic 'unknown customer' value, nor does it adjudicate whether repeated invoice_id/stock_code combinations across the 44721 rows represent amendments versus independent lines beyond the derived identity tuple declared here.
